answer: I ran the 3-qubit GHZ circuit on sirius:mock with 200 shots. The circuit applied H on qubit 0, then CNOT 0 to 1 and CNOT 1 to 2, and then measured all 3 qubits. I built it in Qiskit and compiled it with transpile_to_IQM, which adds the MOVE gates that the Star layout needs. I submitted 1 job, 01a15f17-0f4b-7508-aa3f-32b865f3034b, and it succeeded. The counts were {"000": 200}. This is a mock backend, so its counts do not come from real quantum hardware. A real GHZ run would split mostly between 000 and 111. Mock jobs are free, so this job used no credits. The script is at /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_1a6926f8-f6c-27/scratch/ghz.py. It is not committed.
